title: The bell number can be bigger than the alerts the bell lists
what: The bell's number counts every open alert from the last 30 days, but the list under it shows at most the newest 100. A busy gym with more than 100 open alerts sees, say, 130 on the bell and only 100 alerts to open, and the extra 30 can never be cleared from the list.
expected: The number on the bell matches the alerts the owner can see and clear, or the list says that older ones are hidden and how to reach them.
fix_line: Count only the alerts the list returns, or show 'and 30 older' with a way to see them

title: A member message the gym never answered disappears from the gym after 90 days
what: The gym's Member messages list and its waiting count only look at conversations from the last 90 days, but a conversation is kept for 180 days. A message left unanswered for 90 days drops off the list and the count, so nobody at the gym is reminded of it again.
expected: An unanswered message stays in the gym's list and waiting count until someone answers it or marks it done.
fix_line: Keep unanswered messages in the list and count whatever their age

items.reason: Facts compared: shop orders waiting / ready / sold today (Today card and Shop page read the same 300-row list), a member's order count (counts all orders, the Shop page only the newest 300), money paid for shop orders (online-paid not counted), members in the app (same list on App members and Messages; HQ count is FN-B-truth-hq-app-b-04), bell number vs list. Test gym data too small to prove a difference by recount; no ugly data pack in my inputs.

Sold today uses the India day; 'joined / last seen' text handles just now, across midnight and over 30 days; offer 'window over' and the server's in-now count use the same day edge; open questions are 14 days, inside the 60-day list. No edge fault found in this folder.

Offer 'Joined / Ready / Rewarded' matches its rows' states; Shop tab counts come from the same capped list; bell number exceeds its list past 100. Counts here only fall when the owner acts (gives, collects, reads), so no unexplained drop.
Pairs found: question count vs question list, member-message waiting count vs list, offer counts vs member rows, Everyone (N) vs In the app / Not in the app, bell number vs bell list.

Questions: open means under 14 days, list keeps 60 days, so they agree on a long gap. Member messages: count and list both stop at 90 days while the thread is kept 180 days, so an unanswered message after a long gap leaves both. Offer counts and rows use the same rule.
